interface.longDescription: Explore places and nearby shared bicycles, scooters, mopeds and cars, public transport stops, transport disruption observations, and urban services such as toilets, fountains, Wi-Fi, AEDs, parking, charging and parcel lockers. Uses the existing ROOTE MCP server and its eight read-only tools. Coverage and freshness depend on the sources returned.
